name: 56 dominoes (2 sets)
description: 56 dominoes (2 sets) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.

history.origins: Two double-6 sets (56 tiles total). Used for four-handed partnership or longer games; same block/draw rules. Popular in Spain and Latin America.
timeline: Chinese tile games using bone or ivory tiles evolve into domino sets; European-style dominoes later adopt the double-six composition.
20th century: partnership play with two double-six sets (56 tiles) becomes common in Spain and parts of Latin America to accommodate four or more players.
history.cultural: Partnership dominoes; two sets for 4+ players.

rules.objective: Play all tiles first (your side), or have fewest pips if blocked.
rules.gameplay: All tiles dealt (e.g. 7 each for 4 players). Highest double or bidder leads. Match to open ends; doubles crosswise. First side to empty hand scores opponents' pips; blocked game: lower pip total wins.
keyRules: Match to open ends; doubles crosswise

strategy.basic: Match ends; use two sets for more players or longer games.
strategy.intermediate: Track tiles across two sets; block key suits.
strategy.advanced: Plan for duplicate tiles; partnership communication if 4-hand.
